parameters.name: ResourceCategoryName
parameters.description: The resource categorization name. Optional. If this parameter is not specified, the resource categorization name is not modified. The name of the default resource categorization cannot be modified.

parameters.name: ResourceMatcher
parameters.description: The resource matcher. Optional. If this parameter is not specified, the matching rule is not modified. The format is the same as the ResourceMatcher parameter of the CreateResourceCategory operation.
